content.text: MediaShelf has delivered a candidate implementation.
Consider releasing as a Beta or Experimental interface.  Note that it cannot participate in the XACML security as it not stands.
I'm renaming this because it's (wait for it...) misnamed:
1) we already have (and for the time being, will continue to have) an API-M-Lite which is separate from the fedora-rest project MediaShelf has contributed.
2) the REST-API is not limited to the management interface, but also the access interface (aka API-A).
Related branch dev-144560 was tested and committed to trunk rev. 6414.
We still need some resolution on the Java6 JAXB question (can we include the libs, or do we have the installer say to use Java6, because it doesn't work with Java5 out-of-box as it is)
Create a totally REST-based binding for the Fedora
Selective methods will be implemented - ingest/export.
Continue disscussion on need for full-blown API-M-Lite.
